# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.2 Worker 2: Colonization 3.0 Core — Cold-Start Cure, Golden Loop, Chartered Companies & Late-Game Autonomy (oe_col3_, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v122_col3_core.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# 1. Official Settler Convoy & Pioneer Supply Fleet (3-year CD; cures "+0 pending" cold-start!)
oe_col3_dec_colonial_supply_convoy = {
	decision_category = expansion_decisions
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_3_discovery }
		has_ports = yes
		OR = {
			has_colonial_charters = yes
			has_embraced_institution = institution:new_world
			current_year >= 1460
		}
		OR = {
			has_colonial_charters = yes
			any_owned_location = { is_overseas_for_owner = yes }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		gold >= 100
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_col3_convoy_ready_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_col3_convoy_cd }
		}
		OR = {
			has_colonial_charters = yes
			any_owned_location = {
				is_overseas_for_owner = yes
				population < 15
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_colonial_charters = yes
				gold >= 400
				any_owned_location = {
					is_overseas_for_owner = yes
					population < 8
				}
			}
			add = 25
		}
	}
	illustration_tags = { 10 = exterior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:burghers background = pop_type:peasants } }
	option = {
		name = oe_col3_dec_colonial_supply_convoy.a
		effect = {
			oe_col3_dispatch_supply_convoy = yes
		}
	}
}

# 2. Grant Imperial Parliament Representation (1700+, Age 5-6 Imperial Federation Path)
# Note: subject_loyalty >= 45 uses EU5 1.4.9 flat 0-100 scale.
oe_col3_dec_imperial_federation_seat = {
	decision_category = expansion_decisions
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		current_year >= 1700
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_col3_federation_enacted }
		OR = {
			any_subject = { is_colonial_subject = yes }
			any_owned_location = {
				is_overseas_for_owner = yes
				count >= 6
			}
		}
	}
	allow = {
		current_year >= 1700
		stability >= 10
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_col3_heavy_tariff_crackdown_mod }
		OR = {
			any_owned_location = {
				is_overseas_for_owner = yes
				has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_col3_colonial_governor_palace
			}
			any_subject = {
				is_colonial_subject = yes
				subject_loyalty >= 45
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		value = 10
		if = {
			limit = { stability >= 25 }
			add = 20
		}
	}
	illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:nobles background = pop_type:burghers } }
	option = {
		name = oe_col3_dec_imperial_federation_seat.a
		effect = {
			oe_col3_enact_imperial_federation = yes
		}
	}
}

# 3. Enact Colonial Autonomy Charter (1700+, Age 5-6 Dominion / Commonwealth Path)
oe_col3_dec_colonial_autonomy_act = {
	decision_category = expansion_decisions
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		current_year >= 1700
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_col3_autonomy_act_enacted }

			any_subject = { is_colonial_subject = yes }

				is_overseas_for_owner = yes

	allow = {

	ai_will_do = {

		name = oe_col3_dec_colonial_autonomy_act.a

			oe_col3_enact_colonial_autonomy_act = yes
